representativeLetter.title: Email representatives
representativeLetter.description: Choose a recipient and open the ready-to-send email directly in your email application or copy the individual fields.
representativeLetter.entryDescription: Create a ready-to-send email in just a few clicks.
representativeLetter.processCopy: Copy the finished letter or open it directly in your email application.
representativeLetter.backgroundText: Once loaded, the tool works entirely on your device. Your selection is retained only for the lifetime of this browser tab.
representativeLetter.recipientSearchDescription: Enter a postcode or place, select the matching constituency, and then choose a representative.
representativeLetter.catalogLoadFailed: The local recipient list could not be loaded. Please reload the page.
representativeLetter.locationPrivacyHint: The place or postcode is processed only in the current search field and is neither stored nor transmitted. An exact address is not required.

representativeLetter.locationIncompletePostcode: The postcode is incomplete. Enter exactly five digits.
representativeLetter.locationInvalidPostcode: Enter a valid five-digit German postcode or a place name.
representativeLetter.locationIncompletePlace: Enter at least three characters of the place or municipality name.
representativeLetter.locationNotFound: No reliable local assignment was found. Use the official constituency search below if needed.
representativeLetter.locationChooseConstituency: Deliberately select the matching constituency. Its representatives are shown only after that selection.
representativeLetter.locationAmbiguous_one: The entry maps to one constituency. Please confirm it deliberately.
representativeLetter.locationAmbiguous_other: The entry matches {{count}} constituencies. Check the place, federal state, and constituency, then select deliberately.
representativeLetter.refineLocationSearch: The first 50 constituencies are shown. Enter a more specific place name or a postcode.
representativeLetter.constituencyHint: If the local assignment is unavailable or ambiguous:
representativeLetter.constituencyLookup: Look up a constituency at the Bundestag

representativeLetter.emailMissing: No public email address could be uniquely verified for this person.
representativeLetter.abgeordnetenwatchPublicNotice: Note: Questions and answers on Abgeordnetenwatch may be publicly visible. Do not enter private health or contact details there.
representativeLetter.contentLanguageNotice: The currently approved letter text is German. The English interface uses the same complete German text until an English version is approved.
representativeLetter.recipientMissingPlaceholder: No verified public email address available
representativeLetter.copyManualFallback: Automatic copying is unavailable. The text is selected; copy it with Ctrl+C or Cmd+C.
representativeLetter.signatureNotice: Add your name only when sending, for example through your email signature. Paperwork does not use names or addresses from other forms.
representativeLetter.mailtoDescription: Opens your locally configured email application with the details shown above. Paperwork does not send anything automatically.
representativeLetter.mailtoUnavailable: Choose a recipient with a verified public email address. Otherwise, use the copy/paste fields and the official contact option.
representativeLetter.mailtoBodyTooLong: The subject or mail body is too long for a reliable email link. The email application will open with only the details that can be passed safely; copy the complete content from the fields above.

games.hubDescription: Small low-stimulation mini-games about daily life, pacing, and familiar moments. Everything runs locally in your browser.
games.hubIntro: Start ME Bingo directly in your browser.

meBingo.title: ME Bingo
meBingo.description: A calm 5x5 bingo board with all-too-familiar phrases, situations, and pacing moments.

meBingo.pageDescription: A compact bingo card full of familiar phrases, situations, and everyday classics.
meBingo.introTitle: A short round without time pressure
meBingo.introBody: Draw a card, mark the hits, and see how quickly one line comes together.
meBingo.instructions: 5x5 board, free center tile, no timer, no noise, fully offline.
meBingo.boardHint: Tap matching tiles. The free center tile always stays active.

liveRegion.full-card: Full card detected. The result view was updated.

banner.bingoBody: The card stays open if you want to keep going for a full card.
banner.fullCardBody: There is barely room for any more painfully familiar hits.

result.summaryBingoMany: A lot of classics in a single round.
result.summaryFullCard: The whole board was uncomfortably complete.
result.shareHint: If you want to share it, a screenshot of this result card is enough.
